Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 02 October 2026 02 October 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 01-Oct-2026 300,000 254.5205 251.8000 256.8000 02-Oct-2026 300,000 251.9396 249.4000 255.2000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 963,186,023 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 39,559,991 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 02 October 2026 is 963,186,023 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 11,109,526 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
